cli.discovery: Read cliPath and versionCommand from the local Codex Praetor configuration; never commit a machine-specific path.

model_routing_catalog.authority: The catalog is authoritative for model status and dated public price snapshots. This adapter does not make account-price or automatic-routing claims.

mappings.provider_semantics: Read, Grep and Glob only for a bounded local audit.
Read, Grep, Glob and Bash only for declared deterministic checks in a disposable worker worktree; source edits remain unavailable.
Edit and shell tools only inside the disposable worker worktree.

lifecycle.launch: qoder_cn explicitly starts the configured QoderWork CN CLI with print/stream-json; qoder_global is a separately opted-in Agent SDK route and is never selected by PATH or filename fallback.
lifecycle.parse_terminal_state: watch-codex-praetor-job.ps1 records process state, normalized failure class and evidence state. qoder_cn parses its documented stream-json stdout and treats exit code 0 with no parseable event as provider_output_unparseable; qoder_global may use the separately opted-in SDK event stream.
lifecycle.cleanup: The watcher closes the job lifecycle. qoder_cn uses controlled process cancellation and terminal stdout/stderr evidence; qoder_global may use the SDK session cancellation contract. Cold recovery always starts a new task from Codex ledger state. Retained worktrees are reclaimed only by the controlled cleanup path.

evidence.end_to_end: A first real plan task can perform the bounded current-generation bootstrap automatically in an isolated worktree; a standalone canary remains available for diagnostics.
